name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.16.3 keeps the evidence-first search, three-tier result order, stable selected-product identity, and read-only safety boundaries while making answers warmer, shorter, and easier to scan. The current user message now controls all visible search language before the tool call; English and Chinese progress text stay separate, shopping searches skip Memory and repository reads, and the tool wrapper uses the language-neutral FindCheap name. Product-card interface language follows the user's current request independently from catalog query translation, so Chinese requests keep Chinese card labels even when retrieval uses English terms. Full-size and large-package requests exclude samples, trial packs, trial sizes, and testers before ranking, while the bounded second pass retrieves more eligible brand products. It leads with the strongest supported choice, gives at most two reasons, and ends with one useful next step or limitation. Product cards emphasize the first supported ranked match, localize Coupon labels, keep detailed evidence available on demand, and reduce repeated limitations. Checkout remains the authority for eligibility, stacking, shipping, tax, and final totals. Independently verified Awin merchant-brand evidence remains available during exact matching without weakening unrelated-merchant filtering. Reviewed Awin merchants remain eligible for trusted exact-and-similar matches, while qualifying Shopify results are labeled as high-rated Shopify merchants. Commission never changes product relevance scoring. Railway serves reviewed official storefronts and trusted merchants from schema-valid immutable releases; invalid or unavailable database snapshots cannot replace the last valid registry. Official cards require an approved exact domain, verified product identity, a valid public USD price, and stable product identity. Unsupported sites may use user-authorized Chrome only as a bounded fallback. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, merchant authorization, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: User language only. EN: "Searching for suitable products." ZH: "正在搜索合适商品。" Then tool. No plan/Memory/repo.
